en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> did not Change (His<sup>azwj</sup> Decision) regarding anything except that it was always in His<sup>azwj</sup> Knowledge before that He<sup>azwj</sup> would be Changing it’.
